ModMetaData.name: World Tech Level - Final Guard
ModMetaData.author: Allen / ChatGPT
ModMetaData.description: RimWorld 1.5 compatibility/performance guard for World Tech Level. V2 prevents TraitDef database mutations from triggering a full rebuild of every World Tech Level database. Only the TraitDef tech-level table is repaired locally, with World Tech Level overrides preserved. Fails open to original behavior if the expected World Tech Level internals are unavailable.
